systems.name: NAS_COMB20
systems.subtitle: Combined-premium stop · Tuesday only

evidence.how: Replayed on the 1-minute option chain recorded since 20 Apr 2026.
evidence.caveat: Short sample — 92 days cannot settle a mean this size. The Monday cell was moved to paper on 31 Aug on this evidence.

does: NIFTY weekly ATM straddle; strike = nearest 50 to spot at entry.
09:16, one straddle — sell ATM CE + ATM PE together.
Tuesday only (DTE 0) since 31 Aug 2026. The Monday cell moved to paper as NAS_COMB20_MON.
Combined premium +25% — both legs added and watched as one number. Needs 2 consecutive polls above the level (dwell) before it acts.
15:20 time exit, or the combined stop, whichever comes first.
doesnt: No per-leg stop — one leg can run to any price while the pair stays inside 25%.
No re-entry. Once stopped, the day is over.
No adjustment, no rolling, no re-centring.
NOT covered by the NAS book-level portfolio stop — this sleeve carries its own.
